timing: Frozen before any heldout full-experiment method outcome and before P0-A scientific result.

provenance.native_dynamic_threshold_source: The exact preregistered P0-A thresholds inherited unchanged from the earlier invalid Qwen2.5 contract; they were not selected from Qwen3 or heldout outcomes.
provenance.sqc_equivalence_derivation: Set the SQC invariance margin to one-half of the preregistered native meaningful-shift thresholds: TV 0.025 = 0.5 x 0.05 and max-pattern shift 0.02 = 0.5 x 0.04. This creates a strict separation between a meaningful native effect and an acceptable residual under SQC.
provenance.utility_margin_derivation: A fixed 2 percentage-point absolute success non-inferiority margin is declared before heldout outcomes; it is a design tolerance, not tuned to observed variance.

native_representation_sensitivity.failure_action: Narrow/stop downstream dynamic representation-sensitivity claim; no secondary endpoint may rescue it.

heldout_utility_noninferiority.primary_reference: optimal global support-aware package allocation using the identical shared validator-gated/rejection realization backend and matched resource budget
heldout_utility_noninferiority.criterion: For each taxonomy representation, the paired/cluster-bootstrap lower 95% confidence bound of SQC_success - reference_success must be greater than -0.02; aggregate reporting cannot hide a representation-specific violation.
heldout_utility_noninferiority.failure_action: SQC invariance obtained at material utility loss; stop C3.

semantic_coverage.criterion: No frozen semantic atom may disappear because of the controller. Heldout tool coverage is reported and may not be improved by changing the prior after evaluation begins.

resource_matching.failure_action: If SQC requires a larger matched resource cap to satisfy invariance/coverage, the primary C3 gate fails; report a cost frontier only as secondary analysis.

validator_freeze.allowed_use: Mechanistic support/applicability and realization verification only.
validator_freeze.forbidden_use: May not replace heldout task-success/reference-answer truth or be modified using heldout outcomes.
